brief: Title sting for the photography exhibition Light Falls. Seven of the photographer's own frames, chosen from the curated homepage, dissolve in descending order of measured exposure value: island at noon, a deer in shade, a pylon at dusk, a shark in aquarium light, concert confetti, New Year fireworks, and finally M31. A Geist Mono EV readout and a hairline meter on the right step down with each frame's real EV (read from src/data/photos.json) and fall off the scale at Andromeda. The title rises over the galaxy for the final 2.4 seconds. Photographs are shown unaltered: no grading, no filters, only scale and opacity.
frames_source: src/data/curation.json ids, resolved to public/photos/<file>-1920.avif by build.mjs
